scope: Custom — Monday only: Buffalo Bills at Los Angeles Rams, Monday, October 12, 2026; scheduled kickoff 8:15 PM Eastern Time
historical_cutoff: 2026-10-06T00:00:00-04:00 — after completion of the final scheduled Week 4 game; no Week 5 games included

methodology.eligibility: Named starters, primary/secondary backs with meaningful expected role, top three expected WRs, and top expected TE; current-week depth charts/injury reporting used.
methodology.sportsbook_fallback: FanDuel rows for BUF Bills @ LA Rams were unavailable (0 rows). DraftKings used as explicitly authorized fallback.
methodology.market_line_proxy: User explicitly approved the available DraftKings line whose Over price is closest to -110. Because American odds are nonlinear, closeness was calculated by implied probability distance from -110. This remains an unverified proxy, not a verified main line.
methodology.qualification: Market HR >=6/10 OR any applicable fixed ladder >=8/10.
methodology.hit_rule: For half-point sportsbook lines, historical value must be greater than the line to count as an Over hit.
methodology.twenty_game_25p: Computed from the 20 most recent completed regular-season games before cutoff, using standard linear interpolation.

current_market.selection_method: Available line whose Over implied probability is closest to the implied probability of -110; unverified main-line proxy

records.market_hr_rule: historical values strictly greater than the selected line (equivalent to clearing the line for these half-point markets)
